messages:
Sam: Heads-up — scheduling an infra apply tonight in the quiet window (23:00 UTC). Changes: mesh egress policy tightening, IAM tag enforcement, and module bumps. Need provider/module pin and a clear fallback if anything flakes.

Jia: Can you paste the terraform plan snippet for the IAM tag enforcement so I can eyeball drift?

Sam: ```
# plan excerpt (prod)
~ aws_iam_policy_attachment.prod_tags (update)
  - policy_arn: "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/OldPolicy" -> "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/EnforceTags"
+ aws_iam_role.audit (create)
  + name: "redwood-audit-role"
```

DeployBot: DeployBot: job scheduled -> infra-apply-4570 queued for 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. est runtime 12m. will auto-check plan vs threshold before apply.

Mike: If the apply touches >40 resources we should abort and fall back. Fallback = pin module to current tag + restore previous mesh routes. I can run restore if needed.

Ana: Suggest pinning provider to hashicorp/aws v3.2.1 and network module to module-net v2.3.0 in the release branch. Also prepare an explicit rollback plan: run targeted apply to restore routes/policies.

Sam: Good. I'll add pins and a preflight that writes a tfout for review. Preflight commands I plan to run: 
```
terraform init -backend-config=env=prod
terraform plan -out=prod.plan -var='env=prod' -lock=false
terraform show -json prod.plan > prod-plan.json
./scripts/validate-plan.sh prod-plan.json
```

Jia: Please add a hard hold: DeployBot should not apply if the plan modifies >50 resources or if IAM policy ARNs change to non-expected patterns. Add a manual approval step if either condition triggers.

Sam: Added both checks to the release pipeline and pushed branch release/infra/mesh-iam-pin. Also added a small smoke test to run post-apply: curl internal health endpoints and run a synthetic request through the mesh egress path.

DeployBot: Note: job infra-apply-4570 will auto-abort on threshold breach and post plan summary to this thread. If aborted, it will require manual 'infra-approve' to retry. Pager will escalate on apply failure.

Mike: I'll be on-call during the window. If aborted, I'll coordinate rollback with Ana. @Ana can you prepare the route restore terraform target and an IAM snapshot?

Ana: Oncall + will prepare. Commands I'll run to snapshot IAM state before apply: 
```
aws iam list-policies --scope Local > preapply-policies.json
aws iam get-policy-version --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/EnforceTags --version-id v1 > policy-v1.json
```
And I'll stage a module rollback target: `terraform apply -target=module.route_restore` ready in the repo.

Sam: Final note — no other terraform PRs to prod before the window. If you need to hotfix, coordinate here. :no_entry_sign: 

Jia: :thumbsup: I'll review the prod.plan when it's uploaded.

Mike: 👍 I'll keep my pager ready.

Sam: Thanks team — will update here once preflight plan is uploaded and DeployBot posts the summary.
